correctness.rationale: Every six-state weakly acyclic automaton has a topological relabeling. In a fixed topological order there are exactly 720 possible maps per letter, hence 518400 ordered binary automata. Exhaustive reverse subset-graph BFS over every automaton and all twenty three-subsets gives maximum distance 7. All four topological-order equality presentations are independently replayed by forward BFS, canonicalize to one class, and the representative has a 1440-element orbit under state relabeling and letter exchange.

value.rationale: The direct literature gives a broad gap for binary weakly acyclic subset synchronization; the smallest fixed parameter n=6,k=3 is a natural test of that gap. Closing it exactly at 7 and finding a unique equality class quantifies the extremal behavior of the binary restriction rather than merely providing another witness. The complete finite classification is self-contained and reusable as a benchmark for conjectures about the general extremal function.
